crossRefs.note: We asked them their names also, to inform you that we might write the names of the men who were at their head.

translations.web: They also asked for the names of the men were who were making this building.
translations.bsb: They also asked, “What are the names of the men who are constructing this building?”
translations.kjv: Then said we unto them after this manner, What are the names of the men that make this building?
translations.asv: Then we told them after this manner, what the names of the men were that were making this building.
